issues.description: The UML diagram in the problem statement declares the class as 'Course' while the rest of the exercise (text, template, and solution) refers to the class as 'Lecture'. This naming mismatch between the UML and the provided code can confuse students about the expected class name and where to add attributes and methods.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the UML diagram consistent with the rest of the exercise by renaming the class in the UML from 'Course' to 'Lecture' (or, alternatively, rename the template/solution class to 'Course'). Ensure attribute and method names in the UML match the Lecture class to avoid student confusion.
